newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs close narrowly mixed, investors cautious.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs close narrowly mixed, investors cautious.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed narrowly mixed Monday in low volume as investors were sidelined waiting for companies' third quarter financial results, brokers said.
"Caution is ruling and will last for the next few days," said Hernando Pastor of local brokerage T & J. "We might see some selective buying in reponse to specific company results."
Monday, the General Index climbed 0.28 percent to 1,554.7 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index slipped 0.07 percent to 2,127.7 points, according to preliminary stock figures.
In a total of 1,665 trades, 46 stocks were stable, 25 rose, and 20 fell in meager volume of 21.3 million ($8.3 million).

Brokers said investors were also reluctant to enter the market before the release later this week of the country's gross domestic production (GDP) figure for September, after they were taken by surprise with the economy's slow growth rate in August.

Year-on-year GDP growth was 1.8 percent in August, compared with 7.7 percent year-on-year growth in the same month last year, meaning the economy grew 2.0 percent in the first eight months of the year, compared with 8.4 percent in the same period of 1995.
Accounting for 25 percent of the market's volume Monday, benchmark Telefonica del Peru was the most heavily traded stock as it dipped 0.18 percent to 5.68 soles.
Among other leaders, tin-miner Minsur rose 2.19 percent to 23.30 soles in four percent of the day's volume.
